prompt: Inside a modern fitness gym, rows of treadmills and exercise bikes face a mirrored wall reflecting dumbbells neatly arranged on a weight rack. A flat weight bench sits beside kettlebells and a medicine ball resting on rubber flooring. A coiled jump rope hangs from a pull-up bar above a resistance band draped over a cable machine. A heavy punching bag swings near boxing gloves placed beside a foam roller and yoga block on the floor. A stability ball leans against a rowing machine by a free-weight platform. On the wall, a large clock ticks above a water fountain, and a speaker plays upbeat music near a stack of clean towels. There is no shoe rack, no plastic bag, no magazine, no food wrapper, and no perfume bottle.
